answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can trade, released only after a history of honest work. One fake identity is cheap, but an ocean of sock-puppets each needs its own locked deposit, so forging a thousand agents means parking a thousand stakes. Peers grade each other's work from the terrace of public records, and at dawn of each settlement bad actors forfeit their stake and reputation while honest agents keep both. The attack only pays if fraud earns more than the forfeited stakes, and with stakes sized above one scam's profit, it never does.
